title: move the marker to a number on the number line
seam: each tick: data-tick="<value>" (one element per tick, from min to max every step), centred on its value
the marker: data-marker and data-value="<its current value>" kept current, centred on its value's tick
move controls: data-action="left" and data-action="right" (one step each; the marker never leaves min..max)
the check control: data-action="check" -> Studio.answer({value: <marker value>})
the target, as a number: an element with data-target; the current item's container: data-item="<item.id>"
brief: KIND: game. Placing a number on a number line.

LINE: a horizontal number line from Studio.params.min to max with a tick every step; every labelEvery-th tick labelled with its value written in Studio.params.format (fraction: numerator/den, e.g. 3/4 written with numerals). Ticks are evenly spaced: the x of a value is linear in the value.

ACTIVITY: for each item in order: show the target (data-target) as a number in the same format; the marker starts at Studio.params.start; the child moves it with the two big step buttons (strings left, right_btn) and presses check -> Studio.answer({value: <marker value>}).

On correct: a little hop of the marker, then the next item (the marker returns to start). On wrong: gentle feedback, the marker stays so the child can move it and check again. After the last item: the done text and Studio.done().
Keep values exact: compute marker values as min + k*step and round to 6 decimals; never show more decimals than the format needs.
antiPatterns: ticks placed by index with a different spacing for labelled ticks
floating point drift in the marker value (0.30000000000000004)
the marker starting on the target
